title: Ephemeral Staging Template & Automated Lifecycle Engine

historical_source_deliveries.note: Historical initial source delivery preserved as source history only; superseded by this corrective implementation.

functional.scope: Corrective source implementation of release manifest contract, ephemeral staging provision/ops/verify/destroy controller with mandatory live GCLOUD_BIN & observed resource identity enforcement, genuine boot-disk/data-disk/reserved-IP attachment, stateless cross-run cloud orphan discovery & post-delete readback, preexisting IAM binding preservation, valid GCP cloud labels with epoch TTLs, immutable FE/BFF artifact retrieval & checksum verification via staging_ops.sh, live VM gate collection refusing dry-run/unobserved inputs from staging_verified, prod_preflight evidence alignment, actionlint-clean workflows with staging Environment & WIF/setup-gcloud, runbook, and focused local controller/contract test suite.

hosted.note: Local/mocked tests prove controller and adapter behavior only and do not count as hosted drill evidence.
